sanitization.policy: Derived copies only. Original artifact digests identify the unchanged local originals. JSON values and raw logs retain outcomes, witnesses, measurements and synthetic fixture data; known private absolute path prefixes are replaced with stable placeholders. Runtime PATH/HOME are removed entirely. No original artifact is overwritten.
sanitization.raw_log_handling: 91 original case logs are combined in verifier-case-logs.txt in case order; headings identify the unchanged original log SHA-256. Supplemental output is copied to input-resources.log. Only the same known private path prefixes are replaced in log bodies.
sanitization.source_hash_handling: Source before/after commit, dirty state, input digests and patch digests are preserved. Relevant input hashes are preserved. The complete duplicated source file-hash inventories remain in the original results.json, identified by its SHA-256.
sanitization.synthetic_data: Published example secrets and loopback fixture destinations are synthetic test inputs, not credentials. Raw case logs contained no absolute filesystem paths before sanitization.

supplement.command_provenance: The input raw log records Cargo target launches and outcomes, but not a complete shell invocation; no missing command is reconstructed as observed evidence.
supplement.scope: Schema/input/resource component tests. Their success does not prove that runtime admission consumes every typed resource restriction.
